item.title: Two Shot, One Killed in Early-Morning Incident in Freeland; Investigation Now Considered a Homicide
item.description: Pennsylvania State Police have launched a homicide investigation after a shooting early Tuesday morning in Freeland Borough, Luzerne County, left one teen dead and another injured. The incident occurred around 2:31 a.m. on December 2, 2025. Troopers were first notified when several gunshot victims from the Freeland area began arriving at a local medical facility. item.title: Overturned Tri-Axle Closes Roadway Between Ashland and Gordon
item.description: An overturned tri-axle closed the roadway between Ashland and Gordon Tuesday morning.The incident occurred just before 5:30am between Germanville Road and Country Club Road. The overturned tri-axle blocked the roadway and several utility poles were knocked down during the incident.No injuries were reported.The roadway was closed to clear the scene and allow PPL to fix the utilities.

item.title: North Schuylkill’s Wally Hall Steps Down as Head Football Coach
item.description: After more than ten years at the helm of the North Schuylkill Spartans Varsity Football program, Head Coach Wally Hall has announced he will be stepping down from his position.Hall informed his players of his decision early Wednesday morning. The North Schuylkill School District is expected to release an official statement later in the day.During his tenure, Hall helped shape the Spartans into one of Schuylkill County’s most consistently competitive football programs. item.title: North Schuylkill’s Zilker and Knox Sign Letters of Intent to Play College Football
item.description: North Schuylkill celebrated a major milestone Wednesday as two senior linemen made their college commitments official, signing letters of intent to continue both their academic and football careers at the next level. Senior Aiden Zilker signed his letter of intent to join Temple University, where he will continue his education and compete with the Owls football program. item.description: A Girardville man is facing an extensive list of felony and misdemeanor drug charges after two separate investigations—one in 2024 and another in 2025—resulted in the seizure of large quantities of narcotics, cash, and drug paraphernalia.
